title: Client Craft
description: A modpack that allows you to still play on vanilla minecraft servers, but with extra visual and utility mods.
body:
Client Craft is an immersive Minecraft modpack built for vanilla minecraft servers. It doesn't matter if you are playing a vanilla multiplayer server, or a single player world, Client Craft will look amazing, and have a bunch of tools to help you with every aspect of minecraft.

# Features

### Improved Performance

A bunch of performance mods working together to get the best performance out of minecraft without changing how to game works.

<!--### Enhanced Visuals
Shaders and Resource Packs picked out to make the game look the best it can while still matching the vanilla stile of the game.-->

### Tools

Multiple different mods that make building, designing, exploring, and fighting easier for you.

# Recent Content Update

It's only the first version, so it was just the modpack

# Current Compatablilities

### Minecraft Versions

26.2

### Mod Loader

Fabric

# Upcoming Plans

### Currently Working On

Updating the 26.2 version

### Minecraft Versions

I'm planning on making versions of this modpack for all the big future updates. Also maybe some older versions, depending on how much is needed to be done.

### Mod Loader

I'm planning on adding Quilt if enough people are asking for it

## Mods and Resource Packs

None of this would even be possible without all of the Mods and Resource Packs that have been created, so I want to give a big thanks to all of the creaters of the Mods and Resource Packs listed below.
